item.title: Run Pebble OS in Browser via WASM
item.description:
📝 Pebble Emulator Pebble Emulator Runs entirely in your browser — no server, no install. QEMU is compiled to WebAssembly, emulating the original Pebble ARM hardware and booting real PebbleOS firmware. Firmware: Full PebbleOS SDK PebbleOS Boot May take 2-4 mins to boot Select firmware and click Boot FPS: -- Back Up Select Down Keys: Left=Back, Up/Down=Navigate, Right=Select Serial Console Source on GitHub.
🔗 Read more: https://ericmigi.github.io/pebble-qemu-wasm/
